STATUS UPDATE — IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE AND PUSHED; AWAITING REVIEW VOTES.

Pushed as two stacked changes, both at patch set 2:
  * Gerrit 1240 — single-source the ticket-type map (commit 37439aea48)
  * Gerrit 1241 — guard the ticket-type map like the others (commit cc9b1bba51)
Diff 6 files, +83/-17. Local gates green: make lint, make typecheck (414 files), and 1891 reconciler
unit tests. The mutation verdict and the identical-copies proof are in the earlier comments.

WAITING ON: the LLM-Review vote, which has not been cast on any patch set of either change — the bot
appears backlogged behind this session's load rather than objecting. CI on PS2 was executing cleanly
with all pre-suite gates green at last check.

TWO THINGS A LATER READER SHOULD NOT MISDIAGNOSE:
 * The pip-audit failure that appeared on earlier patch sets is the repo-wide click 8.2.1 /
   PYSEC-2026-2132 block (ticket e47e-a33d-b9cf-4421), not this change. The operator has since
   overridden it and another session fixed its cause.
 * An earlier Verified -1 / Code-Review -1 pair on BOTH changes was a CANCELLATION ARTIFACT, not a
   test failure — Gerrit itself withdrew both votes when real runs started. The mechanism is
   recorded in the CI-infrastructure comment above and is worth reading before rechecking anything.

REMAINING TO CLOSE: land both changes once voted, then close. This is the LAST open P1 child of
epic 3e73-72b5-cff2-40f0; its three siblings (cedc, 79d5, 2944) are closed.
